deterministic_data.verification: Assembly 15/15 ready with zero errors and warnings, including the Factory canonical validator; data_provider python_constant_data_v1 (70_data_provider_closure.json), system_clock python_host_naive_utc_clock_v1, deliverer_router fastapi_sync_v2 from the router closure, runtime_settings from the 6.11 table.

modules.summary: Deterministic model module: the 33 models and enumerations of the State 6 model closure, no contract and no note of its own.

DelivererError carries a RefusalCode and Rejected a PlacementFailure, each assigned unchanged; the answer is built elsewhere from the code alone (A3 rule 5, A5 rule 10). Base class and message are not observable; a placeholder that drops the field breaks its note.
python_constant_data_v1 from 70_data_provider_closure.json: the A8 constants and row tables, MAX_PORT (65535) added after the review (State 7 round 5) as the home of the port bound.

SPEC_STANDARD 6.11: emitted from config.runtime_environment_variables; the A8 table fixes requiredness, defaults and normalisation (positive_integer refuses a port below 1). The review packet does not carry that table (a review-tool gap, reported to the owner); the specification has no freedom here.

A5 rules 6 to 9 and INV-10: one reading per operation, the order of the three refusals, containment strictly below the resolved root. Review findings closed in the notes: _subfolder now restates A5 rule 8 (no segment names the parent folder) instead of walking written segments; _connections_file refuses a byte-order mark.

A1 orders 1 to 9, walking order, ignored names and links, A3 rule 5 condition 1, A7 rule 4: each rejection order lands in one place; an empty scan, a None read or a skipped refusal contradicts a MUST. The OS path separator equals A3's / on the Linux target. Re-reviewed 2026-11-21 after _unlisted_folder became a RETURN_SHAPE helper: it returns the FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE DelivererError and _source_files raises it from the OSError; None, a raise or another code contradicts its note. Re-reviewed 2026-11-21 after A9 rule 3: each opening's flags (folder-only, no-follow, non-blocking, exclusive creation) are named in prose and used unconditionally, their presence never tested; a guarded or probed flag contradicts the note.

A2 rules 1 to 5, INV-03/04/05, A7 rules 4 and 5, INV-14. Review finding closed in the note: the library's own pixel limit is switched off, so only MAX_PIXELS decides a first frame's size (A2 rule 2) and the unreadable_image/too_many_pixels split no longer depends on the library version or a hardening choice.

A6 rules 1 to 5, INV-12/20; A3 rules 2, 5 and 6. Variations of the review closed in the notes: project_lock is the per-open-file lock, so threads of one process wait as processes do; read_placement and read_mark accept only the JSON form of their model, as the writes produce it. Re-reviewed 2026-11-21 after A9 rule 3: each opening's flags (folder-only, no-follow, non-blocking, exclusive creation) are named in prose and used unconditionally, their presence never tested; a guarded or probed flag contradicts the note.
A5 rules 1, 9 and 10 and REFUSAL_ANSWERS: constant-time whole comparison, canonical project id only, status and detail from exactly one row; the constant health answer is the accepted behaviour.
python_host_naive_utc_clock_v1 under rules.time_source_policy: one read per call, naive UTC (A7 rules 1 and 3).
A3 rule 4, A4 rule 2 and A7 rule 2 orders, outcome branches of delivery and mark, scan statuses, INV-06. Variation of the review closed in the note: counts follow the order of the ScanStatus members.
fastapi_sync_v2 table routes from the router closure: four routes, check_token before parse_project_id (A5 rule 1), every refusal through refusal_answer.

A5 rules 2, 4 and 7, A8 EXIT_STATUSES, STOP_SIGNALS, BIND_HOST, flow:service_start: step order and every way the process ends map onto ServiceExit. Hardening of the review applied: load_config refuses a port above the imported MAX_PORT constant. Re-reviewed 2026-11-21 after A9 rule 3: each opening's flags (folder-only, no-follow, non-blocking, exclusive creation) are named in prose and used unconditionally, their presence never tested; a guarded or probed flag contradicts the note.
